title: DFT complex band structure calculations
action: For each material/orientation: r-TiO2 (110), (001), (100), (101); SrTiO3 (110), (001), (111); Sr2TiO4 (001); Sr0.62Ti0.38O4 (001), set up the bulk crystal structure using appropriate lattice parameters, select PBE USPP pseudopotentials, and use a plane-wave energy cutoff of 540 eV. Run Quantum ESPRESSO to compute the complex band structure (imaginary bands) in the band gap along the relevant direction. Extract the imaginary wavenumber κ as a function of energy below the conduction band minimum.
description: Core DFT step; the computed κ(E) curves are needed for the subsequent extraction of m_tunnel. Execution is forced by the load-bearing scored step.

title: Extract effective tunneling mass and produce scored output
action: For each material/orientation, at the energy below the conduction band minimum corresponding to the trap depth (use the values: 1.3 eV for r-TiO2, 0.9 eV for all SrTiO3 and Sr-rich variants), take the imaginary wavenumber κ from the complex band data and compute the effective tunneling mass using the parabolic approximation formula m_tunnel = ħ²κ² / [2(E_CBM - E)], expressed in units of free electron mass m_e. Assemble all results into a JSON array.
description: Scored artifact containing the computed effective tunneling masses for all required materials and orientations. The checker compares these values to hidden gold ranges and relative orderings.
output_schema: JSON array of objects, each with string fields: material, orientation, stoichiometry, and numeric fields: energy_below_CBM (float, eV), m_tunnel (float, units of m_e).
